8a1(mdo sde): @#//glang po ste//sangs rgyas gzugs ni stug na bzhugs//sna tshogs rnam mang gzugs tshul te//sems can bsam bzhin zhugs pa yis//de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam gzhag pa//chu yi zla ba bzhin du snang //sna tshogs gzugs
